instruction: Create a Varnish VCL that strips cookies for static files
output: vcl 4.1; backend default { .host = "127.0.0.1"; .port = "8080"; } sub vcl_recv { if (req.url ~ "\\.(css|js|png|jpg|ico)$") { unset req.http.cookie; } }

instruction: Route based on URL prefix in Varnish
output: vcl 4.1; backend app1 { .host = "127.0.0.1"; .port = "3000"; } backend app2 { .host = "127.0.0.1"; .port = "4000"; } sub vcl_recv { if (req.url ~ "^/api/") { set req.backend_hint = app1; } else { set req.backend_hint = app2; } }

instruction: View Varnish thread pool stats
output: varnishstat -f MAIN.threads -f MAIN.threads_created -f MAIN.threads_destroyed -f MAIN.threads_failed

instruction: Install and configure Varnish with multiple backends
Ban Varnish cache by specific URL pattern
output: varnishadm ban 'req.url ~ ^/api/version'

Set up Caddy with reverse proxy and custom header

Run Gunicorn with gevent async workers
output: pip3 install gunicorn gevent && gunicorn -k gevent --workers 8 --worker-connections 1000 --bind 0.0.0.0:8000 myapp:app --daemon

instruction: Gracefully reload Gunicorn workers
output: kill -HUP $(cat /run/gunicorn.pid)

instruction: Set Gunicorn timeout limits
output: gunicorn --timeout 120 --graceful-timeout 30 --keep-alive 5 --bind 0.0.0.0:8000 myapp:app --daemon

instruction: Install uWSGI with Emperor mode for Python
output:
apt install -y uwsgi uwsgi-emperor uwsgi-plugin-python3 && echo -e '[uwsgi]
http = :9090
wsgi-file = /var/www/app/app.py
callable = app
processes = 4
threads = 2' > /etc/uwsgi-emperor/vassals/app.ini && systemctl restart uwsgi-emperor

instruction: Pass environment variables to uWSGI app
output: echo -e '[uwsgi]\nenv = DATABASE_URL=postgres://user:pass@localhost/db\nenv = SECRET_KEY=production-key' >> /etc/uwsgi/sites/myapp.ini && systemctl restart uwsgi

instruction: Install Passenger for Apache
output:
apt install -y libapache2-mod-passenger && a2enmod passenger && echo -e '<VirtualHost *:80>
  ServerName app.example.com
  DocumentRoot /var/www/app/public
  PassengerEnabled on
</VirtualHost>' > /etc/apache2/sites-available/passenger.conf && a2ensite passenger && systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Install and configure Mailcatcher as SMTP proxy
output: gem install mailcatcher && mailcatcher --ip 0.0.0.0 --http-ip 0.0.0.0

instruction: Benchmark using wrk with custom header
output: apt install -y wrk && wrk -t4 -c200 -d60s -H 'Authorization: Bearer token123' http://localhost/api/users

instruction: Benchmark POST endpoint with wrk
output: wrk -t2 -c50 -d30s -s /tmp/post.lua http://localhost/api/submit

instruction: Load test with vegeta sending requests
output: echo 'GET http://localhost/api/health' | vegeta attack -duration=30s -rate=100 -output=results.bin && vegeta report results.bin

instruction: Run vegeta load test with custom body
output: echo 'POST http://localhost/api/login' | vegeta attack -duration=60s -rate=50 -body='{"user":"test","pass":"test"}' -output=results.bin && vegeta report -type=json results.bin

instruction: Benchmark with siege using concurrent users
output: siege -c100 -t60s -b --content-type 'application/json' 'http://localhost/api POST {"key":"value"}'

instruction: Benchmark with siege from URL file
output: echo -e 'http://localhost/\nhttp://localhost/about\nhttp://localhost/api/status' > urls.txt && siege -c50 -t30s -f urls.txt

instruction: Run ab with keep-alive and gzip acceptance
output: ab -n 50000 -c 200 -k -H 'Accept-Encoding: gzip,deflate' http://localhost/

instruction: Benchmark HTTPS endpoint with ab ignoring cert errors
output: ab -n 10000 -c 100 -Z 'EECDH+AESGCM:EDH+AESGCM' https://localhost/

instruction: Set up Squid with delay pools to throttle bandwidth
output:
echo -e 'acl slow_users src 192.168.1.0/24
delay_pools 1
delay_class 1 1
delay_parameters 1 16000/64000
delay_access 1 allow slow_users' >> /etc/squid/squid.conf && systemctl restart squid

instruction: Configure Squid cache peer for parent proxy
output: echo -e 'cache_peer parent-proxy.example.com parent 3128 0 no-query default\nnever_direct allow all' >> /etc/squid/squid.conf && systemctl restart squid
